title: c4-health — evidence-anchored verdicts, one per audited issue
description: Populated by the audit channel (lib/audit.mjs) — never by gen or check, and never network. Verdict and prose-dependency confirmation provenance is stamped by Forma against the manifest's deterministic `today`; fills cannot supply it. Evidence hashes cover only each record's cited current evidence, never the whole issue snapshot.

type.description: path (file[:line] in the repo), commit (resolvable sha), issue (#N in the snapshot), signal (workflows/<id> or release: the whole run/release record is hashed), milestone (title: the whole record is hashed).

auditedAt.description: Manifest day on which Forma accepted the audit; never supplied by the agent fill.

lastApply.description: Outcome of the last `forma audit --apply` on this overlay: one record, overwritten each time (its history is git, never a register here). What Forma refused is named, so a refusal is visible instead of an abort nobody sees.

unanswered.description: Counter-plan claim ids the verifier returned no result for; they simply get no fresh verdict.

fingerprint.description: Exact fingerprint of one current c4-issues dependency edge whose source is prose.
